request.query: The index of a multivariate polynomial at a point does not change under multiplication by a nonzero scalar

items.name: MvPolynomial.smul_eval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (x : σ → R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (s : R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval x) (s • p) = s * (MvPolynomial.eval x) p

items.name: Polynomial.roots_smul_nonzero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), a ≠ 0 → (a • p).roots = p.roots

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_smul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SMulZeroClass S R] (r : S) (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (r • p).coeff n = r • p.coeff n

items.name: Mathlib.Tactic.ComputeDegree.coeff_smul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_2} [inst_1 : SMulZeroClass S R] {n : ℕ} {a : S} {f : Polynomial R},
  (a • f).coeff n = a • f.coeff n

items.name: Polynomial.roots_C_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R),
  a ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a * p).roots = p.roots
